# 1940 individual calendar months - National defense
def_1940 = [132, 129, 143, 159, 154, 153, 177, 200, 219, 287, 376, 473]
sum_1940 = sum(def_1940)
print(f"1940 Total: {sum_1940}")

# 1953 individual calendar months - National defense and related activities
def_1953 = [3632, 3501, 3789, 3891, 3746, 4056, 3890, 3519, 3787, 3647, 3540, 3465]
sum_1953 = sum(def_1953)
print(f"1953 Total: {sum_1953}")

# Formula: |V1 - V2| / ((V1 + V2) / 2) * 100%
# Or using the first value as reference: |V1 - V2| / V1 * 100%

# Using the reference as 1940
abs_pct_diff = abs(sum_1953 - sum_1940) / sum_1940 * 100
print(f"Absolute Percent Difference (using 1940 as reference): {abs_pct_diff:.2f}%")

# Alternative interpretation - between the two totals
abs_pct_diff_alt = abs(sum_1953 - sum_1940) / ((sum_1953 + sum_1940) / 2) * 100
print(f"Absolute Percent Difference (using average as reference): {abs_pct_diff_alt:.2f}%")
